newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aboitiz up 10.34 pct in late session.
newsitem.headline: Aboitiz up 10.34 pct in late session.

text.p: Aboitiz Equity Ventures rose 30 centavos, or 10.34 percent, to 3.20 pesos in late session on Tuesday due to its bid for the privatisation of the country's largest water utility, brokers said.
"Maybe investors see Aboitiz Equity as a potential winner in the privatisation of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc.
Traders have predicted plays this week on listed companies that have joined the MWSS bidding.

The financial proposals for the water privatisation bids are due to be opened on Wednesday. Other local companies, also bidding for the project in partnership with international firms, are Ayala Corp, Benpres Holdings Corp and Metro Pacific.
Aboitiz was among the heavily traded issues on Tuesday with 9.89 million shares changing hands in late session.
Aboitiz is a holding company with interests in energy, shipping, banking and transport.
